User wants a consistent weekend morning routine without waking too early and likes sleeping in a bit (S1.U1). Saturday wake time is now 7:30 a.m. (S2.U2; superseded: 8:30 a.m., S1.U2), followed by coffee and a 30-minute jog; assistant suggested starting around 8:15–8:30 a.m. (assistant suggested, S2.U2–S2.U3). User lives in a downtown area and wants a relatively flat, shaded route (S2.U3), plans to use online route-finding tools, and will check for water fountains/drinking stations (S2.U3–S2.U5). They prefer no earbuds while jogging to stay aware of their surroundings (S2.U6). They also plan to check the weather forecast later (S2.U1).

For Sunday, the user is considering 30 minutes of yoga/stretching to loosen up after a week sitting at a desk, followed by quick breakfast and weekly meal prep (S1.U2–S1.U3). They prefer starting small and increasing gradually (S1.U2–S1.U3).

User wants to improve focus and retain information when tired, particularly while reading (S1.U6). They want to read 30 minutes nightly and chose Eric Ries’s *The Lean Startup* because of their interest in entrepreneurship, building startups, and applying the framework to their projects (S1.U4–S1.U6).
